recipe.historicalReuse: All historical periods have already been reviewed. This is chronological research, not an untouched holdout or live record.

targets.stocks: Next available SPY session open to close; assumes publication before that open.
targets.crypto: BTC full UTC session source date + 2 calendar days, open to close; no borrowing the partially elapsed publication-day return.

recipe.trainingLabelRule: Target close date must be strictly before prediction source date; extra one-source-session embargo. Production comparator additionally requires matured three-session labels.
recipe.ridgeRefit: First eligible source date of each calendar month, using only then-mature labels and training-only standardization.
recipe.features: Production stationarized six-feature vector plus 1/5/20/60-session own returns and trailing 20-session daily volatility; no news, future prices or parameter search.
recipe.tradingDiagnostic: Common session open-to-close, fully closed each session, unit long/short exposure. Forecast-driven challengers trade only above fixed round-trip cost. Raw production uses its existing market-label boundary; filtered comparator uses actual permission. Risk and exposure differ; do not rank profitability without them.
recipe.riskForecast: EWMA of matured target squared returns, decay 0.94, versus rolling-training constant variance. Evaluate QLIKE and absolute-return MAE with RMS-to-absolute normal conversion explicitly approximate.
recipe.promotion: No automatic promotion. Require improvement over base return/probability forecasts, no deterioration in recent and annual slices, cost-robust economic benefit, then locked prospective evidence. Historical selection can never satisfy the prospective requirement.
recipe.prospective: Freeze recipe and code/data fingerprints. Write dated predictions before their target opens and append outcomes only after close; no backfilled prediction counts as prospective. No production policy change in this experiment.

caveats: Historical reconstruction from current stored, unadjusted open/close quotes, not original data vintages or actual executed trades. Publication timing is an explicit assumption, not historical delivery verification.
All 2020-2026 periods have previously been inspected. Chronological fits prevent lookahead but do not remove historical model-selection bias.
SPY open-close excludes overnight returns and dividends. BTC targets start at the first full UTC session after assumed next-day noon publication. This sacrifices freshness to avoid a fictional entry.

Production scores target different one/three-close blends; only directional and trading diagnostics are comparable. They are not probabilities or return forecasts for this target; their Brier/MSE are unavailable.

All models are evaluated on identical dates within a market. Cash earns zero; always-up reopens every target session and pays the same round-trip costs, not buy-and-hold. Gross result is also reported.
Unit-exposure long/short diagnostics omit borrow, financing, variable spreads, taxes, position sizing and latency. Cash/exposure differ; cumulative returns do not establish investable superiority.
Paired 20-session block intervals are descriptive, not multiple-testing-adjusted significance. Windows differ between markets and must not be combined.

No production model change is selected by this report. Genuine prospective evidence requires predictions timestamped before future target opens. Local shadow locks are append-only files, not a hosted daily collection service.

continuousHoldingContext.caveat: Additional context, not matched target exposure: continuously invested including overnight/weekend gaps, one entry/exit, no dividends, financing or taxes. Daily intraday always-up is not buy-and-hold.
